first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Gray Racetrack
entities.identification: A gray paved road surface that converges forward from the lower part of the main view and curves around the base of the wall and the foot of the slope on the image-left.

entities.name: Metal Guardrail
entities.identification: A silver-gray horizontal-beam guardrail extending along the outer edge of the curve outside the structure's exit.

entities.name: Red-and-White Curb
entities.identification: A curved strip with alternating red and white sections along the inner edge of the curve on the image-left side of the road.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: The blue-sky areas along the upper edge inside the rearview frame and above the main view after exiting the structure.

entities.name: Lake Surface
entities.identification: A narrow strip of flat blue-gray water outside the guardrail on the image-right side of the main view.

entities.name: Gray Concrete Structure
entities.identification: A passage structure located above and on both sides of the road during the initial segment, enclosed by a gray roof slab and vertical side walls.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: A low, bright yellow vehicle in the foreground on the image-left side of the main view, with black tires and silver-gray wheels; a dark, slanted windshield is exposed in the later segment.

entities.name: Racing Interface Overlay
entities.identification: The position and timing text overlaid on the scene, the horizontal rearview frame at the top, the route map at the lower left, and the circular gauge at the lower right.

entities.name: Slope Beside the Racetrack
entities.identification: The outlines of the slopes and steep walls rising above the road on the image-left and ahead, excluding the surface vegetation.

entities.name: Slope and Roadside Vegetation
entities.identification: The green cover on the slope, the taller tree crowns at the top of the slope, and the low grass inside the Red-and-White Curb.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The nearer silver-white vehicle in the image-left portion of the top rearview display, with a light-colored front end, a dark windshield, and a darker lower section.

entities.name: Vehicle D
entities.identification: The dark vehicle farther away to the image-right of Vehicle B in the top rearview display, appearing smaller.
